sql_text: SELECT a.aircraft_code, a.model, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS flight_count FROM aviation.aircrafts AS a LEFT JOIN aviation.flights AS f ON f.aircraft_code = a.aircraft_code WHERE a.range_km >= 6000 GROUP BY a.aircraft_code, a.model

SELECT t.ticket_no, tf.flight_id, tf.amount FROM aviation.tickets AS t JOIN aviation.ticket_flights AS tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no WHERE t.passenger_id = '1318-041314' AND tf.fare_conditions = 'Business'

WITH passenger_totals AS (SELECT t.passenger_id, t.passenger_name, COUNT(*) AS segments, SUM(tf.amount) AS total_spent FROM aviation.tickets AS t JOIN aviation.ticket_flights AS tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no WHERE t.ticket_no BETWEEN '0000000434847' AND '0000000484847' GROUP BY t.passenger_id, t.passenger_name) SELECT passenger_id, passenger_name, segments, total_spent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_spent DESC) AS spending_rank FROM passenger_totals WHERE total_spent >= 55000 ORDER BY spending_rank LIMIT 100

SELECT f.flight_id, f.flight_no, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count, SUM(tf.amount) AS revenue FROM aviation.flights AS f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights AS tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE f.flight_id = 40536 GROUP BY f.flight_id, f.flight_no
SELECT scheduled_departure::date AS flight_date, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM aviation.flights WHERE departure_airport = 'SVO' GROUP BY scheduled_departure::date ORDER BY flight_date

WITH route_counts AS (SELECT departure_airport, arrival_airport, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM aviation.flights WHERE status = 'On Time' GROUP BY departure_airport, arrival_airport) SELECT departure_airport, arrival_airport, flight_count, flight_count::numeric / SUM(flight_count) OVER (PARTITION BY departure_airport) AS traffic_share FROM route_counts ORDER BY traffic_share DESC

SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue FROM retail.categories c JOIN retail.products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id JOIN retail.order_items i ON i.product_id = p.product_id JOIN retail.customer_orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE c.category_id = 26 AND o.ordered_at >= DATE '2023-06-30' - INTERVAL '180 days' GROUP BY c.category_name

SELECT p.brand, o.sales_channel, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders, SUM(i.quantity) AS units, AVG(i.unit_price) AS avg_price FROM retail.products p JOIN retail.order_items i ON i.product_id = p.product_id JOIN retail.customer_orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE p.brand = 'Brand 14' AND o.order_status <> 'cancelled' AND o.ordered_at >= DATE '2025-05-21' - INTERVAL '365 days' GROUP BY p.brand, o.sales_channel ORDER BY units DESC

SELECT a.city, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders, SUM(o.total_amount) AS gross_sales FROM retail.addresses a JOIN retail.customer_orders o ON o.shipping_address_id = a.address_id WHERE a.region = 'Region 3' AND o.ordered_at >= DATE '2025-04-19' - INTERVAL '180 days' GROUP BY a.city ORDER BY gross_sales DESC

SELECT ordered_at::date AS day, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue, AVG(discount_amount) AS avg_discount FROM retail.customer_orders WHERE sales_channel = 'web' AND ordered_at >= DATE '2024-01-20' - INTERVAL '90 days' AND ordered_at < DATE '2024-01-20' + INTERVAL '90 days' AND order_status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY ordered_at::date ORDER BY day

SELECT p.payment_id, p.order_id, p.amount, o.customer_id, o.ordered_at FROM retail.payments p JOIN retail.customer_orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE p.payment_status = 'failed' AND p.payment_method = 'cash' AND o.ordered_at >= DATE '2023-04-09' - INTERVAL '120 days' AND o.ordered_at < DATE '2023-04-09' + INTERVAL '120 days' ORDER BY o.ordered_at DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(i.quantity) AS units, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue FROM retail.customer_orders o JOIN retail.order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN retail.products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.ordered_at >= DATE '2023-06-14' - INTERVAL '120 days' AND o.order_status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered') GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(p.payment_id) AS payments, SUM(p.amount) AS lifetime_value FROM pagila.customer c JOIN pagila.payment p USING (customer_id) WHERE c.customer_id >= 262 GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING COUNT(p.payment_id) >= 3 ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) FILTER (WHERE f.rating = 'G') AS g_revenue, SUM(p.amount) FILTER (WHERE f.rating = 'PG') AS pg_revenue, SUM(p.amount) FILTER (WHERE f.rating = 'R') AS r_revenue FROM pagila.payment p JOIN pagila.rental r USING (rental_id) JOIN pagila.inventory i USING (inventory_id) JOIN pagila.film f USING (film_id) WHERE p.payment_date >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2022-01-01' AND p.payment_date < TIMESTAMPTZ '2022-02-01' GROUP BY i.store_id ORDER BY i.store_id

SELECT f.film_id, f.title FROM pagila.film f WHERE f.rating = 'NC-17' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pagila.inventory i JOIN pagila.rental r USING (inventory_id) WHERE i.film_id = f.film_id ) ORDER BY f.title

SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name FROM pagila.customer c WHERE c.activebool = true AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pagila.rental r WHERE r.customer_id = c.customer_id AND r.rental_date >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2022-04-01' ) ORDER BY c.customer_id

SELECT i.film_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.store_id = 1) AS store_one, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.store_id = 2) AS store_two FROM pagila.inventory i WHERE i.film_id >= 3 GROUP BY i.film_id HAVING ABS(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.store_id = 1) - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.store_id = 2)) >= 3 ORDER BY i.film_id

SELECT p.customer_id, p.payment_date, p.amount, lag(p.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY p.customer_id ORDER BY p.payment_date) AS previous_amount, p.amount - lag(p.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY p.customer_id ORDER BY p.payment_date) AS delta FROM pagila.payment p WHERE p.customer_id >= 491 ORDER BY p.customer_id, p.payment_date
